question: The phenomenon of dispersion of light was first explained by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Isaac Newton**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phenomenon of **dispersion of light** was first explained by the English physicist and mathematician **Sir Isaac Newton** in the year **1666**.
 
• Through his landmark experiments with **glass prisms**, Newton demonstrated that **white light** is not a single entity but is actually composed of a **spectrum** of different colors.
 
• He observed that when a narrow beam of sunlight passes through a triangular glass prism, it splits into a band of seven colors, commonly known as **VIBGYOR** (**Violet, Indigo, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, and Red**).
 
• Newton concluded that different colors of light bend through different angles with respect to the incident beam as they pass through the prism. **Violet light** undergoes the **maximum deviation**, while **red light** undergoes the **minimum deviation**.
 
• To confirm that the prism was not adding color to the light, he placed a second identical prism in an inverted position with respect to the first one, which allowed the separated colors to **recombine** into **white light**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dispersion**: This is defined as the splitting of a composite beam of light into its constituent colors when it passes through a transparent medium like a **prism** or a **water droplet**.
 
• **Refractive Index and Wavelength**: The cause of dispersion is that the **Refractive Index** of a material varies for different **wavelengths**. Since each color has a specific wavelength, they travel at different speeds within the medium, leading to different degrees of refraction.
 
• **Christiaan Huygens**: A Dutch scientist who proposed the **Wave Theory of Light** in **1678**. He suggested that light travels in the form of longitudinal waves through a hypothetical medium called "ether."
 
• **James Clerk Maxwell**: A Scottish scientist who developed the theory of **Electromagnetism** in the **1860s**. He mathematically proved that light is an **electromagnetic wave** that can travel through a vacuum.
 
• **Albert Einstein**: A German-born physicist who explained the **Photoelectric Effect** in **1905**, for which he received the **Nobel Prize in Physics** in **1921**. He introduced the concept of **photons**, establishing the particle nature of light.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Natural Dispersion**: A **rainbow** is a prime example of dispersion of sunlight caused by **water droplets** in the atmosphere. This process involves **refraction**, **dispersion**, and **Total Internal Reflection (TIR)**.
 
• **Visible Spectrum**: The range of wavelengths visible to the human eye is approximately **400 nm to 700 nm**. **Violet** has the **shortest wavelength** and highest frequency, while **red** has the **longest wavelength** and lowest frequency.
 
• **Newton's Opticks**: Isaac Newton published his detailed findings on light and color in his famous book titled **"Opticks"** in **1704**, which laid the foundation for modern physical optics.
